stem:
Lochan looks at the diagram. The marking shows $\triangle PQR \cong \triangle XYZ$.

Which claim correctly names the side that corresponds to side $PQ$?

teacher.key_rationale: Congruence notation pairs vertices in order: P with X and Q with Y, so PQ corresponds to XY. Pairing with YZ, with a side of the same triangle, or with XZ misses that order.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source right triangle as two congruent triangles PQR and XYZ with congruence statement.
